title: Indexed program-image provenance
requirement: WHEN preparation indexes a supported source program, it SHALL produce a ProgramImage preserving source membership, original function-table order and SourceOccurrenceId provenance.
expectedSource: spec text only; no expectation was derived from implementation behavior

scenarios.name: Distinct occurrences and recursive references
scenarios.when: Two source sites contain the same expression and a named function recursively calls itself.
scenarios.then: They retain distinct SourceOccurrenceId values while recursive calls remain function-table references; expanded implementation-step IDs map back to those sites. Ordered child/parameter slices and first-match lookup remain as in the source until a separately admitted unique-function profile applies; preparation neither evaluates the selected path nor unrolls recursion.

expected.identical source sites: two textually identical f(n - 1) call sites keep distinct occurrence ids
expected.recursion: calls name the function-table entry (3 call sites: entry plus two) and are not unrolled (image size independent of entry argument)

unasserted: expanded implementation-step ID to site mapping

scenarios.name: October 19 refinement: every declaration and repeated parameter (UIREQ-027)
scenarios.when: body typing visits declarations, including unused and later same-named declarations.
scenarios.then: a repeated parameter SHALL fail at its second binder, consistent with owner V4.
unasserted: unused/later same-named declarations; first-match signature lookup vs owner V3

checks.label: repeated parameter fails at second binder
